name: LemonChat.app (Stranger Chat)
entry_flow: Enter nickname -> Pick Text or Video -> Accept terms -> Start
protection_summary: No email required; free gender filter and instant report/skip.

classification.reason: Initial guess: guest/nickname auto-signup flow with no CAPTCHA

selectors.composer_input: textarea:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="message" i]:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="chat" i]:not([disabled]), input[placeholder*="type" i]:not([disabled]), [contenteditable="true"]
selectors.skip_button: button[aria-keyshortcuts="Escape"], button.skip-btn, button.next-btn, button[aria-label*="Skip" i], button[aria-label*="Next" i], button[aria-label*="Stop" i]
selectors.chat_ended_text: stranger has disconnected|partner disconnected|chat ended|left the chat|looking for a stranger
